'''Ramón Rossell Mas'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Rossell|Mas}} (born 24 June 1971) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed at the [[1992 Winter Olympics]] and the [[1994 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="Olympedia">{{cite web |url=https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/96957 |title=Ramón Rossell |work=Olympedia |access-date=12 May 2021 |quote=Full name: Ramón Rossell Mas}}</ref><ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ro/ramon-rossell-1.html |title=Ramon Rossell |access-date=25 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418073018/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ro/ramon-rossell-1.html |archive-date=18 April 2020}}</ref>
